{{Infobox character | name = Porphy | image = Porphy.png | race = Hearthian | planet = Timber Hearth | location = Village }} __NOTOC__ '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a hearthian winemaker, but their sap wine is more known in [[The Village|the village]] as more of a chore rather than a pleasure. They call their product '''the Good Stuff'''. == Dialogue == === Initial Conversation === * “Heyo, hatchling!
I hear you're leaving us to seek adventure amongst the stars. When you return, let's you, me, and [[Gossan]] open up a bottle of the Good Stuff.” ** '''>I'm only seeking adventure amongst one star, actually. Other stars are too far away.''' *** “Another metaphor ruined in the name of scientific accuracy.
Nevertheless, I do hope you enjoy your travels. Good luck!” ** '''>The Good Stuff is less "delicious sap wine" and more "daunting digestive challenge".''' *** “An iron stomach is the mark of a true Hearthian, my friend.
Our hardy hunter-gatherer lifestyle stems from trial and error. By which I mean our ancestors survived eating a lot of bad things.” === Followup Conversation === * “Ho, the astronaut returns!
Tell me, what I can do for you?” ** [[#Question Menu|Question Menu]] === After going to space === * “Oh my, and here I thought I’d heard your ship take off. Was your adventure only a short one?” ** [[#Question Menu|Question Menu]] === Question Menu === * '''>Any new dirt?''' ** “I'm hoping to teach [[Esker]] to tap trees next time they return from [[the Attlerock]]. If they'll bring me lunar sap, I can attempt moon wine!” * '''>What are you up to?''' ** “I've just finished sealing up another batch of sap wine for aging. I like to begin aging a batch on the day of a significant occasion, you know!
That's why there are so many bottles labeled "structural collapse" and "house fire".” * '''>I'm good, actually.''' ** “Enjoy your travels!” == Trivia == * Esker, who has a habit of sending their Little Scout on clandestine "visits" to the village, recommends in their signalscope log that someone tell Porphy and Gossan that their flirting "is ''not'' subtle from an aerial perspective." * As all Hearthians they are named after minerals. Porphy is likely named after [[wikipedia:Porphyry_(geology)|porphyry]], which is any of various granites or igneous rocks with coarse-grained crystals such as feldspar or quartz dispersed in a fine-grained silicate-rich, generally aphanitic matrix or groundmass.
